title: Game profile rules
brief: Screen where users map a game's executable name to a mouse profile, with a master switch for automatic switching. Used by the process watcher; settings are enabled flag plus an ordered list of {executable, profile} rules.

artboards.title: Section inside the profiles dialog
artboards.tradeoff: Reuses the existing dialog and needs no new navigation; hidden behind the profile menu and gets long as rules grow

artboards.title: Dedicated Games panel
artboards.tradeoff: Easy to find, shows rule priority and reordering; adds a new navigation entry and the most code

artboards.title: Sentence-style rules
artboards.tradeoff: Reads like plain language and explains how to find the executable; no explicit priority control and less dense for many rules
